drivingQuestion: Up to what width does R' Yehuda permit an alleyway entrance without diminishing?
outcomeNote: The question is taken up in the next unit (Rav Aḥai's a fortiori), where it is left undetermined.

segments.he: וְהָרָחָב מֵעֶשֶׂר יְמַעֵט. אָמַר אַבָּיֵי, תָּנָא: וְהָרָחָב מֵעֶשֶׂר יְמַעֵט, רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: אֵינוֹ צָרִיךְ לְמַעֵט. וְעַד כַּמָּה?
segments.en: The opening mishna states: If the entrance to an alleyway is «wider than ten» cubits, «one must diminish» its width. «Abaye said» that a Sage «taught» in the Tosefta: If the entrance to an alleyway «is wider than ten» cubits, «one must diminish» its width. «Rabbi Yehuda says: He need not diminish it.» The question arises: «Until what» width does Rabbi Yehuda still permit carrying in the alleyway?
